messages:
Emily Park: Heads-up  Partner 'BoltEdge' wants minute-level usage for their marketplace SKU. Need a small integration playbook and test window.
Omar Ruiz: I can take ingestion. Must have idempotency, HMAC sig, and replay semantics. Also propose 2-tier backoff: 1m -> 5m -> 15m.
Sophie Patel: Partner ops: we can do 1m sends but will honor backoff header. They want same-day billing if events arrive within 12h.
Liam Chen: Monitoring: alert if 5xx > 0.4% for 10m or avg_ingest_lag > 90s for 10m. On those signals, auto-switch partner to 15m batched mode.
Emily Park: Reconciliation expectations?
Omar Ruiz: We'll run daily recon and provide CSV diff. Add arrival_latency metric and a small delta tolerance (0.25%). Over that -> manual review.
metering-bot: staging-smoke: 2025-09-10T02:00Z - 1800 events, 0 sig fails, duplicates 0.1%
Sophie Patel: Payload contract will include: device_id, iso_timestamp, tz_offset, usage_min, sku, signature, replay_id, adjustment_flag (optional).
Omar Ruiz: Sample payload to circulate:
Omar Ruiz: ```
{
  "device_id":"bolt-001",
  "iso_timestamp":"2025-09-10T01:59:00-07:00",
  "tz_offset":"-07:00",
  "usage_min":1,
  "sku":"BOLT-EDGE-STD",
  "signature":"sha256=...",
  "replay_id":"r-20250910-01"
}
```
Liam Chen: Post-cutover plan: 1) QA replay to staging 2) 1% prod canary for 20m 3) 10% for 30m 4) full enable. Reconciliation runs 09:00 UTC daily for 7 days.
Emily Park: I'll coord partner ops and schedule Zoom. Pin rollback signals in channel. :thumbsup:
